relationships.subject: cannabidiol
relationships.evidence_quote: it showed that CBD generates calcium influxes, demonstrating that it has biological activity and functional communication with TRPV1

key_findings: Human odontoblast-like cells and gingival fibroblasts express functional CB1 and CB2; LPS and Poly-I:C upregulate both, CB2 more strongly.
CBD-induced calcium influx was attenuated by CB1, CB2 and TRPV1 antagonists, suggesting cannabinoid receptor-TRPV1 crosstalk.
